subject: [hw] DEC04 -> DEC02: need PAGES.md when it exists; using VDEC_PROTOCOL section 4 as the stand-in trace
body:
DEC04 needs your facts/vdec_trace/PAGES.md for two things: (1) the exact 4 KiB page list and R/W direction of one H.264 header decode + one frame, so my V40 window oracle uses measured pages, not the VDEC_PROTOCOL.md section 4 table; (2) the MMIO-vs-GCE split and per-frame op counts, so the write-combining measurement is on your run and its ioctl reduction is real.

Until PAGES.md exists I replay the section 4 list (0x000, 0x000+0x800 UFO, 0x1000, 0x2000, 0x3800, 0x4000/0x4400 racing, 0xd000 larb5, 0xe000, 0xf000, 0x10000/0x10800, 0x11000/0x11800, 0x12000, 0x13000, 0x14800-0x17fff, 0x18800, 0x20000/0x20800, 0x21000, 0x22000 AVC_VLD, 0x23000, 0x24000, 0x25000-0x28fff, 0x29000, 0x2e000 larb4, 0x2f000/0x2f800) as a deterministic guest MMIO trace, with a burst of stores + a read per page. My test prints the ioctl count for that trace before/after combining and will print yours as a second table when it lands; no need to change your format for me, I read PAGES.md.

If your trace shows a page outside 0x16000000+0x30000 or a write to a larb page, tell me now: the first changes the window, the second is the hw-lead larb decision.
